consequence.statement: Empty strings in drop_labels configuration are no longer evaluated, which corrects the handling of this configuration parameter in lambda-promtail.

original.statement: The lambda-promtail tool no longer evaluates empty strings when processing drop_labels configuration.

consequence.statement: No operational consequence. The upgrade fixes a lambda-promtail panic that happened when the DROP_LABELS env var was empty. Behaviour that worked before is unchanged, and no operator action is needed.

corrected.statement: lambda-promtail no longer evaluates an empty drop_labels value, which fixes a panic caused by mishandling an empty DROP_LABELS env var (#11074). This is a bug fix, so the operator has nothing to do.

decision.reason: The same section restates PR 11074 as "Fix panic in lambda-promtail due to mishandling of empty DROP_LABELS env var" [ev-4f0f13cefd09], which matches the changelog line [ev-fff1292f7fe3]. If the operator does nothing, the upgrade itself removes a crash, and nothing that worked before now works differently. So there is no operational consequence: the kind should be none (informational), not behavior-change. Both proposers also suggested the informational class.
